description: Header file defining the BufferPool class for managing a pool of Metal buffers in the ANGLE project, including methods for initialization, allocation, commit, release, and destruction of buffers.

classes.name: BufferPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of Metal buffers for dynamic data streaming in the ANGLE renderer.

methods.name: BufferPool
methods.description: Constructor that sets whether to always allocate new buffers.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the buffer pool with context, size, alignment, and max buffers.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates a region in the buffer pool, possibly creating a new buffer.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Flushes written data to the device, making it visible.

methods.name: releaseInFlightBuffers
methods.description: Releases buffers that are no longer in use.

methods.name: setAlwaysAllocateNewBuffer
methods.description: Sets whether to always allocate new buffers on allocate.
